items.title: 13.2 Trend in volatility of the halogens (halogens ki volatility ka trend) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.2 with Table 13.2 and Quick Check 13.1, printed page 293.

blocks.text: Halogens non-polar hain, yani in ke molecules par koi permanent (hamesha rehne wala) charge ka farq nahi. Is liye in ki volatility ka faisla zyada tar instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces (ek pal ke liye bane dipole se paida hone wali halki attraction) karti hain. Yeh forces molecule ke size, shape (shakal) aur polarizability (electron cloud kitni aasani se bigarta hai) par depend karti hain. Forces jitni strong (mazboot), volatility utni kam aur boiling point utna zyada. Jin substances mein id-id forces weak (kamzor) hain aur molecules chhote aur kam polarizable hain, un ke boiling points kam aur volatility zyada hoti hai. Bare, zyada polarizable molecules mein London dispersion forces strong hoti hain; un ke boiling points zyada aur volatility kam hoti hai.

Volatility aur boiling point ulte chalte hain (inversely related): jo substance zyada volatile hai us ka boiling point kam hoga. Strong intermolecular forces hon to molecules ko liquid se alag kar ke gas banane ke liye zyada energy chahiye. Khulasa Table 13.2 mein hai.

blocks.text: Pehle do halogens, fluorine (colourless, yani be-rang, ya bohat light green) aur chlorine (greenish yellow), weak id-id forces ki wajah se gases hain. Bromine liquid hai kyun ke is ka size bara hai aur is mein fluorine aur chlorine se strong intermolecular forces hain. Iodine mein group ki sab se strong forces hain, is liye yeh room temperature par solid hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Kaun se halogen elements radioactive hain?
blocks.explanation: Astatine (At) aur tennessine (Ts). Yeh dono bohat rare aur radioactive hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Halogens ke rang different (alag alag) kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Har halogen ka molecule nazar aane wali roshni ka kuch hissa absorb karta hai, kyun ke molecule ke andar electrons ek energy level se doosre par jate hain (electron transitions). Yeh energy group mein neeche jate hue badalti hai, is liye absorb hone wala rang aur hamein nazar aane wala rang badal jata hai: chlorine greenish yellow, bromine reddish-brown, iodine ki bhaap violet.

blocks.prompt: c) Chlorine, bromine aur iodine se zyada volatile kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Cl₂ molecules teenon mein sab se chhote aur halke hain aur in mein electrons sab se kam hain. Is liye in ke darmiyan id-id (London) forces sab se weak hain aur molecules ko alag karne ke liye kam energy chahiye. Natija: chlorine gas hai aur jaldi phail jati hai, jab ke bromine liquid aur iodine solid hai.

blocks.prompt: Halogens ki volatility ke trend mein London dispersion forces ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: X₂ molecules non-polar hain, is liye in ke darmiyan sirf London dispersion forces hain. Yeh forces electrons ke number aur polarizability ke saath barhti hain: F₂ mein sab se weak, I₂ mein sab se strong. Is liye neeche jate hue boiling point barhta aur volatility kam hoti hai.

items: Halogens non-polar hain; in ki volatility id-id (London) forces se tay hoti hai.
Bara size aur zyada polarizability: strong forces, zyada boiling point, kam volatility.
F₂ aur Cl₂ gas, Br₂ liquid, I₂ solid.
